# sensor_calibration - bench-derived calibration data for the ICU-20201 receivers.
# rx_thresholds.c is generated by
# src/apps/pitch_catch_mode_hardware_test/receiver_readout/host/calibrate_thresholds.py.
# include/sensor_calibration.h also holds the measurement config (TX burst, ODR, range) shared
# by every app. include/sensor_offsets.h holds the transducer-to-unit-base mounting offsets
# (TRANSMITTER_OFFSET, RECEIVER_OFFSET) added to the sensor's range.
# See docs/threshold_calibration.md.

idf_component_register(
    SRCS "rx_thresholds.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "include"
    REQUIRES invn-soniclib
)
